coverage.summary: Applies to rental dwelling units offered for rent by housing providers for residential purposes, other than units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.
coverage.owner_conditions: Units in owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units are not 'rental dwelling units'.

evidence.quoted_span: owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units

“Rental dwelling unit” means a dwelling unit offered
for rent by a housing provider for residential purposes,
other than a dwelling unit in an
owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.

“Rental dwelling unit” means a dwelling unit offered
for rent by a housing provider for residential purposes,
other than a dwelling unit in an
owner-occupied premises of not more than four dwelling units.

result.notes: The existing coverage is supported by the definition of 'Rental dwelling unit' in section 3 of P.L.2021, c.110 (C.46:8-54). No change was needed. The act states no unit-count minimum, construction cutoff, new-construction exemption, landlord-size condition or preemption terms, so those fields stay null. Section 12(e) preserves independent rights of action, including LAD claims; it does not address local rules, so yields_to_local_rule and supersedes_state_rule stay null.
